author: Tobias Halloran
description: The Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC)’s AI Factory Accelerator Programme, now in full operation following a pilot initiative, gives startups access to sovereign compute, technical support and training to support innovation across industries.  Many of these companies are also members of the NVIDIA Inception program for cutting-edge startups — and as of today, access to some […]
title: Spain-Based Startups Advance Regional Innovation With Barcelona Supercomputing Center
